comparison.objective: Insert a heater plug into the safe floor socket; candidate adjusts and validates a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Millimeter-clearance plug alignment and insertion versus tool seating, bimanual stabilization, collar tuning, and torque-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Heater connected to the floor socket rather than the loaded strip versus two controlled carriage stops. Exact insertion thresholds and separate spec versions were not provided.
comparison.reason: Electrical connection selection and insertion do not test adjustable damping.
